name: toolchain
description: Turn grounded evidence into requirements and business-facing PRDs while enforcing target-surface delivery verification, production invariants, resource hygiene, and isolated repository work.

interface.shortDescription: Requirements, PRDs, delivery gates, and safe repository work
interface.longDescription: Toolchain composes source-owning plugins to ground stakeholder evidence, analyzes it into Requirements and Action Items, creates six-section business-facing Product Requirements Documents, produces approval-gated specifications and validation agendas, owns storage and process cleanup eligibility, and applies the user's standing target-surface delivery gate plus Sentry Logs observability invariant to separately authorized production work. It also scopes repository writes, disposable artifacts, and task-spawned processes to removable remote-backed clones. These constraints never authorize implementation, deletion, process interruption, or deployment by themselves.
defaultPrompt: Elicit requirements evidence from this source
Analyze this evidence into Requirements and Action Items
Create a six-section business-facing Product Requirements Document
Turn these requirements into a specification or validation agenda
Verify every changed path through its real target-surface entry point before shipping
Enforce the Sentry observability invariant for this production change
Identify only legitimate storage or process cleanup candidates
Isolate this repository work before making changes
